is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-east) (page 5, 'Molecular species identification and detection of pyrethroid resistance alleles').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 12 (page 13) provides the frequency of vgsc-1014F and 1014S alleles by region, and the text states approximately 50 mosquitoes were genotyped per site (page 5).

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses field-collected Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) from 14-16 sites in Mali (page 2, 'Study area').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting field collections and laboratory analysis (PCR) of mosquito samples (page 3, 'Mosquito larvae collections and rearing').

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for specific districts and regions in Mali (Table 1, page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers the period 2016–2018 (page 1, Abstract).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and monitoring conducted annually from 2016 to 2018.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype frequency data is provided in Figure 12.

assessment.summary: This study monitored insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) across 14-16 sites in Mali from 2016 to 2018. It assessed resistance intensity to pyrethroids, carbamates, organophosphates, and neonicotinoids, and genotyped kdr-west (L1014F) and kdr-east (L1014S) mutations in 2017 and 2018.
